replaces: nothing: status missing (no derivative work before this row)

args.name: nc
args.inactive_reason: Integer column count of the LW call, fixed by the wrapper.

args.name: nl
args.inactive_reason: Integer model layer count (59 on hrrrv5 x1.2562), fixed by the wrapper.

args.name: nz
args.inactive_reason: Integer ozone climatology level count (noznlev = 59), fixed by the configuration.

args.name: k
args.inactive_reason: Integer level of this launch (the wrapper launches k = nl-1 .. 0).

args.name: pmid
args.reads: pmid[c, k] for c < nc (model layer pressure in hPa, from mpas_pressure_mb)

args.name: pin
args.inactive_reason: Fixed ozone climatology pressure coordinate (pools['atm_input']['pin'], rrtmg_lw_v842.py:1400), read from the init file and never written by the model.

args.name: ozone
args.reads: ozone[c, 0] (top), ozone[c, nz-1] (bottom) or ozone[c, u..u+1] (interior) per column

args.name: starts
args.inactive_reason: Integer common search start per level; the forward atomicMin-reduces starts[k-1]. Not differentiable; the derivative reads its pre-launch words to rebuild the trajectory's bracket.

args.name: upper
args.inactive_reason: Integer bracket index carried per column across levels. Not differentiable; the derivative reads its pre-launch words.

args.name: out
args.writes: out[c, k] for c < nc (o3vmr at level k); every other word untouched (identity)

branches.inactive_reason: Launch index against the fixed column count.

branches.predicate: pin[kk] < p && p <= pin[kk+1] (search from starts[k])
branches.inactive_reason: The bracket index u is an integer choice frozen at the trajectory (rebuilt from the pre-launch pmid, pin, starts, upper); the selected ozone words and p stay active.

branches.tie: the arm the forward executed at the trajectory; the map is continuous at both knots, so the frozen arm gives the one-sided derivative

branches.inactive_reason: Integer bound on the bracket index; the forward's zero continuation is constant (no tangent).

limiters: frozen-coefficient: the bottom arm p > pin[nz-1] is a constant clamp (out = ozone[c,nz-1], d out/d p = 0); the top arm scales to zero (out = ozone[c,0]*p/pin[0]); the interior is linear between bracketing levels. Branch and bracket are frozen at the trajectory and only the executed piece is differentiated. No min/max of active values.

refusal.domain: p, coefficients, seeds and written derivative words finite; interior bracket index u in [0, nz-1]

precondition: pmid, pin, ozone, starts, upper, out are distinct allocations (no aliasing); one thread per column owns pmid[c,k], ozone[c,*] and out[c,k], so the adjoint is deterministic with no atomics; the primal starts/upper are the pre-launch words (the window binds primal without post to its pre-launch copy)
precision: the f32 primal words the partials use (dpu, dpl, dpl+dpu) are formed as the forward forms them (__f*_rn, --fmad=false --ftz=false; the harness-only __check is bitwise to the forward image on out, upper and starts); local partials in double; one rounding to f32 per written derivative word (the glue-row rule)
